import pandas as pd

# Analyze season 1 data to confirm October peak
trips_s1 = tables['trips'][tables['trips']['fish_date_season'] == 1].copy()

# Group by doy to see patterns
doy_stats = trips_s1.groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
    'yt': ['sum', 'mean', 'count'],
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()

doy_stats.columns = ['doy', 'total_yt', 'avg_yt_per_trip', 'trip_count', 'total_anglers']

# Calculate average share per trip (rough estimate)
doy_stats['avg_share'] = doy_stats['total_yt'] / doy_stats['total_anglers']

# Filter October (doy 287-305)
october_data = doy_stats[(doy_stats['doy'] >= 287) & (doy_stats['doy'] <= 305)]

print("=== SEASON 1: October Peak (DOY 287-305) ===")
print(october_data[['doy', 'trip_count', 'avg_yt_per_trip', 'avg_share']].to_string())
print(f"\nOctober Average Share: {october_data['avg_share'].mean():.4f}")
print(f"October Average YT/Trip: {october_data['avg_yt_per_trip'].mean():.2f}")

# Filter April-May (doy 92-121) for comparison
spring = doy_stats[(doy_stats['doy'] >= 92) & (doy_stats['doy'] <= 121)]
print("\n=== SEASON 1: April-May (DOY 92-121) ===")

print(f"Spring Average YT/Trip: {spring['avg_yt_per_trip'].mean():.2f}")
